assets.notes: Slash_sprite_effects — 10 numbered slash-effect animations. Variants are explicit (01-10), NOT guessed elemental meanings from color alone. Variant 01 is runtime-confirmed; 02-10 stay reference until the runtime adopts them. PNG frames are spawned melee effects (melee-effect-frame); EPS frames map to their PNG via sourceOf. Locked 2026-08-15.
